review.summary: Adds `DISCORD_MENTION_ID` and appends a validated `<@id>` mention on its own line, reserving room for it inside the 1800-character limit while leaving the no-mention path unchanged. Strict 17-20 ASCII digit validation blocks @everyone/here and newline injection, and the change ships with thorough Pest coverage plus the required docs, CHANGELOG entry and config wiring. I would approve this as is.
